scope: Read-only runtime observer for exactly rr-retained-quit-01/02/03 and rr-retained-kill-01; no native sample run yet
green: 2 helper tests passed: actual nonblocking flock contention/release and fresh typed action -> exactly 10-second deadline; stale/canary/bool actions rejected
ready: Approved binary SHA at observer start, ready and end; actual retained-inspect schema/root/nonce; at least one durable step; live expected Codex creation identity; retained worker direct parent is that PID; stable flock is held. Does not wait for model final; records actual last native turn state.
stop: Observer starts before controller action; only a fresh matching action file establishes 10-second stop deadline. Success requires original native/worker creation identities gone, same lock device/inode available, same segment/worker record. PPID is not process creation identity.
idle: After ordinary resume, observe 10 seconds with new native PID live, old worker gone, lock available, identical checkpoint/prefix hashes, and no task_started since the declared resume timestamp. No explicit user continuation is sent by this observer.
effects: Retained-inspect validates authoritative records; observer retains only ordered step numbers, byte lengths and SHA256, never raw effect payloads.
limits: Synthetic single foreground Go process only; no process tree or arbitrary CLI guarantee. Runtime system calls have OS timing limits. Tests do not impersonate native CODEX_THREAD_ID or count as model evidence.
temporary_fixture_cleanup: TemporaryDirectory lock fixture removed after tests
